policy: kill first; SPAN_UNDERIVED candidates are ineligible (R377 evidence-derivation requirement); R397 Phase 2: DOES_NOT_BEAT_BASELINE and PLAUSIBILITY_BOUND_VIOLATED candidates are ineligible for release (the machine's own physics gates the claim); among survivors prefer better E15-B verdict, then BEATS_BASELINE, then fewer deficient areas, then fewer UNCERTAIN attack outcomes; NO numeric score is computed (CEO standing rule: no new scoring systems)

ranked.mechanism: Temperature-dependent degradation of lithium inventory at the negative electrode due to graphite phase separation dynamics during fast charging.
ranked.intervention: Implement a diagnostic routine that applies a controlled high-rate charge pulse to the cold battery and monitors for an immediate, transient voltage sag or internal resistance spike that clears only upon full thermal recovery, confirming graphite phase separation as the root cause of the intermittent sensor fault.

ranked.mechanism: Temperature-dependent changes in internal battery impedance and voltage drop under load, particularly related to phase separation dynamics affecting charging efficiency and cell balance.
ranked.intervention: Measure the DC resistance and internal impedance of the battery and charging system at room temperature and below 0C, comparing state-of-charge and state-of-health to identify thermal threshold faults.

ranked.mechanism: Model-informed control exploiting internal cell physics to manage charge rate based on electrochemical state
ranked.intervention: Implement a temperature-compensated idle-speed and alternator field-duty-cycle control algorithm that increases engine RPM and regulator output below 0C to maintain minimum charging voltage, mirroring the paper's physics-based protocol adjustment.
